name: Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce
author: Nashir Uddin

sections.description: Added video to product gallery along with images on product single page of WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload woo-product-video-gallery.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

JS Libraries Used

The Third party libraries, non-compiled version of JavaScript and/or CSS-related documentation and source code can be found at the following links:

  1. assets/js/product-video-gallery-for-wc-videojs.js: For the creation of Video Player. Documentation, Source Code
  2. assets/js/product-video-gallery-for-wc-youtube.min.js: For the display of Youtube Video. Source Code
